python3 -c "
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/home/agent/workspace/migration.db')
conn.execute('PRAGMA user_version = 0;')
conn.commit()
print('integrity:', conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check;').fetchone()[0])
conn.close()
" && file /home/agent/workspace/migration.db && ls -la /home/agent/workspace/migration.db
